name: Stellar Sleep
one_liner: Insomnia app with short daily lessons based on CBT-I and ACT, a sleep diary and relaxation audio, paid by subscription after a short trial.
best_for: Adults with ongoing insomnia who want a structured self-guided program
People who want short daily lessons and a sleep diary
People who prefer working on sleep without medication
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who may have sleep apnea or another medical sleep problem (see a doctor first)
People who want a free or low-cost option (it is a fairly expensive subscription)
short_description: A subscription insomnia app with 5-10 minute daily lessons built on CBT-I and ACT, plus a sleep diary and relaxation audio.
long_description: Stellar Sleep is an insomnia app from Merlin Collective that started at Harvard Innovation Labs. Daily 5-10 minute lessons cover the main parts of cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia, such as sleep restriction, stimulus control and changing unhelpful thoughts about sleep, and the company says it also draws on acceptance and commitment therapy. A sleep diary tracks your progress, with relaxation audio and journaling. After a 7-day trial you choose the price of, it is a subscription: Stellar's FAQ says programs start at $188, and a July 2026 check of the checkout reported $188 a month, with a 30-day refund window. No peer-reviewed study of the app itself was found; the company's claim that it beat sleeping pills comes from its own unpublished assessment.
patient_summary: Stellar Sleep gives you a short lesson each day to help you change the habits and thoughts that keep insomnia going, plus a sleep diary to track your nights. You start with a low-cost 7-day trial, then pay a subscription that the company says starts at $188.

pricing.starting_price: About $188/month after a 7-day trial (price varies by program)
pricing.notes: Stellar's FAQ says the basic program starts at $188 and varies by program and length; a competitor's July 2026 checkout check found a pay-what-you-choose 7-day trial ($0.99-$18.37) then $188 a month, with a 30-day refund. Older reviews quoted $63/month. Check the price at checkout.

privacy.notes: Policy (dated September 2022) says it does not sell personal information but uses it to show targeted ads, including with third-party ad partners.

seo.meta_description: Stellar Sleep is an insomnia program based on CBT-I, with 5–10 minute daily lessons, a sleep diary and relaxation audio.

faqs.q: How much does Stellar Sleep cost?
faqs.a: Low-cost first week, then a subscription. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Stellar Sleep before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Stellar Sleep replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Stellar Sleep is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Stellar Sleep?
faqs.a: Stellar Sleep is available on iPhone and Android.
Daily CBT-I lessons; Sleep diary and trends; Relaxation and sleep audio; Worry and gratitude journaling.
